title: 02a-tdma.md:25 'distinct sync word or LLSec flag' beacon discriminator unclear
description: From b7z9.156 edge review (finding E1). spec/02a-tdma.md:25: 'Beacon uses distinct sync word (0x34 per spec) or LLSec flag. Old nodes MUST ignore (backwards compatible).' 0x34 is the standard LICHEN sync word on ALL LICHEN frames (spec 02 3.2), so it is not beacon-distinct; 'old nodes' is ambiguous (Meshtastic 0x2B nodes vs pre-TDMA LICHEN nodes); and the two discriminators are joined by 'or' without saying which one a receiver relies on. After the b7z9.156 wire-format fix there is also no beacon type byte, so frame-type discrimination matters. Clarify which mechanism makes non-TDMA nodes ignore beacons. Pre-existing text; P4 clarity.
